title: Validation readiness run
purpose: Prove the durable OOS-to-WGCF execution boundary with a bounded read-only validation and readiness evaluation.

lock_strategy.reason: The proof reads validation and readiness truth and performs no canonical mutation.

compensation_strategy.reason: The activity has no canonical business-state side effect; WGCF stages local evidence per attempt and commits it atomically only after process-group exit is confirmed.

cancellation_boundary: Operator cancellation sends the admitted cancel control and interrupts the active activity or waiting run. Unexpected activation-evidence loss makes the ordinary worker fail-stop immediately and leaves generation retirement unconfirmed. Planned retirement requires Platform to quiesce start ingress, prove ordinary workflow pollers are zero, and issue a digest-pinned manifest for the business queue and generation start registry. OOS seals the durable registry, reconciles and cancels exact registered workflow IDs before one-shot polling, verifies terminal projections, and emits a generation-retirement receipt. Temporal Visibility is diagnostic only. A fresh activation requires a new manifest digest and the prior generation's accepted retirement receipt, while WGCF retains already-written local evidence.
completion_condition: WGCF returns a ready terminal decision and OOS records the aggregate receipt projection.

rollout_and_rollback.suspension_behavior: Deny new runs and retain definition and run projections.
rollout_and_rollback.rollback_behavior: Platform quiesces and drains start ingress, scales ordinary OOS workflow pollers to zero, and issues a digest-pinned generation-retirement manifest. OOS seals the generation start registry, reconciles and cancels exact registered workflow IDs before one-shot polling, verifies terminal projections, and emits the receipt required before Platform may issue a fresh activation digest.
